description.value: Ato Sushi Bar + Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant in Surrey, BC, co-founded by Chef Insung Cheon and Chef Jongyeon You, who together bring over a decade of Japanese cuisine expertise. The kitchen is known for its oshi (pressed) sushi alongside a broad menu of donburi, tempura, teriyaki, and udon dishes, with everything from sushi rice vinegar to sauces made in-house. Cyclists passing through will find a full sit-down restaurant experience with takeout and delivery options as well.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 23m; stands (2 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 71m; stands (6 spaces) at 87m; stands (6 spaces) at 97m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at atosushi.ca is fully accessible and confirms the business is active with a complete menu, contact details, and online ordering through Uber Eats, Skip The Dishes, and DoorDash. The website address is consistently '5570 152 Street' across all subpages, while OSM records '5571' — a clear discrepancy flagged below; the website value is used per rule 12. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields are null. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by 'CALL FOR DINING RESERVATIONS OR TAKE-OUT ORDERS' and multiple delivery platform listings; vegetarian options are confirmed by numerous menu items (Veggie Tempura, Veggie Gyoza, Veggie Udon, Tofu Teriyaki, Edamame, etc.).
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records '5571 152 Street' but the website consistently shows '5570 152 Street' across all pages. Website value used.
OSM community is listed as 'Tsawwassen' but the business website clearly identifies its location as Surrey, BC.
OSM has no phone number; phone 778-574-2258 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Japanese restaurant with confirmed takeout options and vegetarian menu items — a practical stop for touring cyclists in the Surrey area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegetarian items confirmed on menu: Veggie Tempura, Veggie Gyoza option, Veggie Udon, Veggie YakiSoba, Tofu Teriyaki, Edamame, Gomae, Agedashi Tofu, Avocado Salad. No explicit vegan or GF labelling observed
